job.title: Software Developer
job.description:
Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects.

Who we are supporting 

The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.

The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including:

Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats.
Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations.
Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces.
Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks.
Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers.

Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities.

The program 

Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS)

The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO’s principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V.

To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. The IWCs are a critical part of the overall NCI Agency workforce and make up approximately 15 percent of the total workforce.

Software Developer
Role ID – NATOIS-0049

Role Background

NATO International Staff requires a Software Developer – Expert Consultant to support the Defence Planning and Policy Division, Defence Planning Directorate, Data Analysis Section.

The role focuses on developing and maintaining solutions for data collection, analysis and visualisation, particularly web applications and dashboards supporting defence-planning data analysis.

Role Duties and Responsibilities

Design, develop and deploy web-based dashboards.
Develop and configure web applications using modern web frameworks.
Develop and test data-collection solutions.
Transform and integrate data from classified and unclassified sources into web-based systems.
Perform data conversion and preprocessing using Python APIs and ETL tools.
Develop and improve data-collection tools based on stakeholder requirements.
Develop and maintain documentation for code, service endpoints and system architecture.
Support security testing and approval activities.
Test solutions with stakeholders and ensure requirements are met.
Develop data-driven dashboards for senior leadership using Python and/or Power BI.
Support workshops and stakeholder engagements.
Provide knowledge transfer and training materials.
Report on progress and identify potential project/timeline risks.
Brief NATO International Staff and leadership on project progress.

Essential Skills

JavaScript and HTML.
Modern web development frameworks such as React, Vue.js or Angular.
MS SQL.
Python for automation, ETL and data analysis.
Python libraries including pandas, NumPy and Matplotlib.
Development of data-driven dashboards using Python and/or Power BI.
Backend services and/or data-processing pipelines.
Data integration and preprocessing.
Git/version control.
Agile project management.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

 

Desirable:

Practical .NET experience

Experience

Minimum 5 years of web development experience using JavaScript/HTML and frameworks such as React, Vue.js or Angular.
Extensive MS SQL experience.
Experience developing dashboards for senior stakeholders.
Strong Python experience for automation, ETL and analysis.
Experience building and maintaining backend services or processing pipelines.

educations and Certifications

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology or a related field.
Advanced English.

job.title: FULLSTACK DEVELOPER - ENTERPRISE AI PLATFORMS (GEMINI)
job.description:
FULLSTACK DEVELOPER ENTERPRISE AI PLATFORMS (GEMINI)

Location: Remote | Type: Full-time / Contract

About Newpage Solutions

Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organisations including pharmaceutical, biotech and healthcare leaders to build transformative AI and data-driven technologies addressing real-world health challenges.

From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human-centred practices.

We are proud to be Great Place to Work certified for three consecutive years, hold a top Glassdoor rating, and were named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview. We foster creativity, continuous learning and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people's lives.

Your Mission

We are hiring a Fullstack Developer who knows the Gemini platform from the inside how Gemini Enterprise is administered, how agents, data connectors, extensions and Gems are built, registered, scoped and distributed, and how access and permissions actually flow through them.

You will be embedded with a large enterprise client as part of a small engineering pod, alongside engineers who own other enterprise AI platforms. You will own the path by which new data connectors, agents and skills reach users: from intake through access group creation, identity provider synchronisation, connector registration, per-tool permission scoping, testing, documentation and closure with the requester. You will review third-party components for security and quality before release, and replace manual console work with automated, repeatable pipelines.

This is not an administration role. Most of your time goes into building: the backend services, data mappings and integrations that wire the platform into the client's systems, and the internal tooling that gives platform owners visibility and control over how AI capabilities are being used. You should be as strong in the backend APIs, identity, data, infrastructure as code as you are in the UI.

You won't wait for a refined backlog or a separate platform team. You will take a vague request, work out what is actually needed, build it, and stand it up in production yourself. This is a builder role for engineers who combine solid fullstack fundamentals with a deep, practical understanding of the Gemini platform and its extension model.

What You'll Do

Build & Integrate


Design and build the backend services, APIs and data mappings that connect Gemini to enterprise systems identity, data sources, ticketing and the connectors in between.
Build internal tooling and admin interfaces (React / Next.js over Python or TypeScript backends) that give platform owners visibility into usage and control over which capabilities are available to whom.
Build or integrate agents and extensions for the client's own use cases Agent Designer, ADK, Gemini CLI extensions, or LLM-powered services and agents on whichever orchestration framework fits (LangGraph, Google ADK, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK or similar), integrating models through APIs, tool calling / MCP and structured outputs and register them in Gemini Enterprise so the right people can use them.
Take a vague request from a business or platform owner, work out what is actually needed, ship a working version quickly, and harden what survives contact with real users.


Own Connector & Agent Requests End to End


Own data connector, agent and skill requests for the enterprise Gemini platform from intake through to closure with the requester.
Create access groups and manage identity provider synchronisation (SSO / SCIM with Okta, Entra ID or Google Cloud Identity) so access follows existing team and group structures.
Register connectors and data stores and apply per-tool permission scoping, granting only the access each capability needs.
Test each connector and agent before release, document what it does and how to use it, and close the loop with the requester.


Configure, Distribute & Review Platform Capabilities


Configure and distribute agents, skills, extensions and Gems to the right audience enterprise-wide, group-scoped or on request with a clear understanding of the scoping controls and what each one actually gates.
Conduct security and quality reviews of third-party and externally authored agents, extensions and connectors before release: dependencies, bundled scripts, and exposure to prompt injection or data exfiltration.
Define remediation or approval decisions and document them so the standard is repeatable.


Automate Provisioning


Automate setup, registration and provisioning through CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code (Terraform) in place of manual console configuration.
Build parameterised deployments across development, staging and production environments.
Turn recurring manual requests into reusable, version-controlled automation.


What You Bring


5+ years building production fullstack applications in Python and TypeScript APIs, integrations and modern web frameworks (FastAPI, Node / Fastify, React / Next.js). You are backend-strong: data mappings, integration plumbing and wiring systems together is where you spend most of your time, not just the UI.
Deep, hands-on knowledge of the Gemini platform: Gemini Enterprise administration (data connectors and data stores, agent registration, end-user feature controls, IdP-synced groups and access) and the Gemini API, plus Gemini for Google Workspace (Gems and admin controls) where it is in use. You know how capabilities are packaged, scoped and distributed and where the sharp edges are. Familiarity with Vertex AI and the agent stack (ADK, Agent Runtime, Agent Registry, A2A) is useful rather than essential.
Hands-on experience with Gemini function calling / tool use and MCP servers, including tool permissions and capability scoping.
Hands-on experience building agents or LLM integrations with at least one orchestration framework (LangGraph, Google ADK, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK or similar), and comfortable switching the team's framework is not fixed.
Security-minded reviewing of code and AI components: dependency analysis, script review, and a practical understanding of prompt injection and data exfiltration risks.
CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Cloud Build or similar) and infrastructure as code with Terraform across AWS, Google Cloud or Azure, including parameterised multi-environment deployments.
Structured, disciplined use of AI-assisted development (Gemini CLI, Claude Code or similar) with review, not on autopilot.
Clear written communication, and the confidence to reframe a vague request into something concrete rather than wait for someone else to define it.
Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science or a related technical discipline.


Bonus Skills / Experience


Working knowledge of a second enterprise AI platform Claude (Claude Enterprise, Claude Code), Microsoft Copilot Studio, AWS Bedrock or Azure AI Foundry. A strong plus: you will be expected to provide cover across platforms.
Background in AppSec, supply-chain security or security review processes.
Experience in pharma, life sciences or other regulated industries.
Relevant cloud or security certifications (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Terraform Associate).
A recent public trail of built things GitHub, side projects, OSS contributions, or writing about building with AI.


What We Offer

At Newpage, we're building a company that works smart and grows with agility where driven individuals come together to do work that matters. We offer:


A people-first culture supportive peers, open communication, and a strong sense of belonging.
Smart, purposeful collaboration work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges.
Balance that lasts we respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life.
Room to grow opportunities for learning, leadership, and career development, shaped around you.
Meaningful rewards competitive compensation that recognises both contribution and potential.


Ready to Apply?

Let's build the future of health together. Apply below or reach out to shubhi.tiwari@newpage.io with any questions.

job.description:
IoT Integration Engineer (Smart Home Devices, PropTech product)
Remotely from Krakow or near (with rare occasional onsite presence)
B2B contract full-time 

About the role
ElevateOS integrates with 20+ smart-device ecosystems — keyless entry, locks, cameras, switches, thermostats, etc. Every integration is validated against physical hardware before release. 
We're hiring the person who owns that pipeline: the physical device lab, the hardware itself, and the environments and networking that keep everything running.
You'll set up and maintain the smart devices, test environments, and networking behind our device integration pipeline, working directly with the development team and CTO with real autonomy — you decide how the lab and tooling evolve. The role centers on hands-on hardware ownership and diagnostic problem-solving, with servers and infrastructure as part of the environment you support.

About ElevateOS
ElevateOS has been improving the resident experience for over seven years. We built a single, all-in-one platform that lets property managers and resident staff work together, replacing multiple confusing apps with one intuitive solution. The product is stable, growing, US-based. Our stack is JavaScript end to end: React, Node.js, and React Native.

Requirements:
Hands-on experience with smart home / IoT devices — locks, cameras, sensors, hubs, thermostats, or similar
Solid Linux and networking fundamentals — comfortable in a terminal, SSH, logs, DNS/DHCP/port-level debugging
Strong at reading documentation and code (JavaScript/TypeScript) to independently identify where a problem is
Based in or near Kraków (hardware will be hosted at your home - a standard workspace, no additional room is needed)
Solid commercial technical experience (not junior)
Good English communication.

What you'll own
The physical device lab — smart locks, access-control hardware, cameras, switches — in Kraków 
Setup, configuration, firmware updates, troubleshooting, and inventory
Test environments and servers — install, configure, and maintain the local and staging environments our integrations run against; adjust configurations live during debugging sessions with developers.
Lab networking — device connectivity (Wi-Fi, BLE, Zigbee/Z-Wave), router and network configuration, and remote access so the dev team can reach devices and environments from anywhere.
Integration testing — install iOS/Android builds, run end-to-end tests against physical devices, API testing, reproduce and isolate bugs, verify fixes with the team.
Documentation — device matrix, environment runbooks, test protocols, and findings.
Occasional in-person device handoffs in Kraków.

Job Title: Shopify Developer

Job Location: Poland, Remote 

Job Type: Contract (6-12 months)




SENIOR SHOPIFY DEVELOPER




We are seeking a Senior Ecommerce Developer with a deep understanding of the Shopify platform. This role requires deep expertise in Shopify’s ecosystem, strong front-end engineering skills, and the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

You will partner closely with developers, designers, business analysts, projects managers, and stakeholders to deliver exceptional commerce experiences.




Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain custom Shopify and Shopify Plus storefronts & POS extensions
Develop custom themes, sections, and Shopify Functions using Liquid, React, React Native, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Build and integrate custom Shopify apps using Shopify APIs (JavaScript, APIs)
Implement and/or integrate advanced checkout, cart, and subscription customizations
Optimize storefront performance, accessibility, and SEO
Implement integrations with third-party systems (ERP, OMS, CMS, PIM, payment providers, analytics, etc)
Collaborate with UX/design to advise & implement pixel-perfect, responsive experiences
Troubleshoot complex production issues and provide long-term solutions




Required Qualifications

5+ years of professional web development experience
3+ years of hands-on Shopify and Shopify Plus development
Strong expertise in: Shopify Liquid, JavaScript and HTML / CSS
Experience with Shopify Storefront API, Admin API, and GraphQL
Experience building or extending custom Shopify apps
Deep understanding of Shopify theme architecture (Online Store 2.0, Horizons)
Familiarity with modern front-end tooling (Webpack, Vite, npm/yarn)
Experience with Git and modern CI/CD workflows
Strong debugging and performance optimization skills
Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders




Nice to Have

Experience with Shopify POS & React Native
Experience with Headless Shopify (Hydrogen, Next.js, Remix)
Shopify Plus experience (Checkout Extensibility, Scripts, Functions)
Experience with React or similar frameworks
Knowledge of eCommerce best practices (conversion, merchandising, SEO)
Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG)
Shopify certification(s)
